Part of a combined Rs 1,500 crore FY26-28 capex program (New Malur, Siliguri, Gorakhpur plants plus debottlenecking); plant-specific investment value for Siliguri not separately disclosed. New capacity expected to come on stream from H2 FY27 through FY28. Self-executed; no separate civil contractor disclosed.

name: KP Green Engineering Matar Galvanizing and Fabrication Facility
description: KP Green Engineering Ltd commissioned a new steel fabrication and hot-dip galvanizing facility at Matar village, Bharuch district, Gujarat, adding 2.94 lakh MT per annum of capacity and featuring what the company describes as Asia's largest galvanizing kettle (56 cubic metres, 1,100-tonne zinc capacity). Facility was inaugurated by Gujarat Deputy CM Harsh Sanghavi on 24 Dec 2025; company states total operational capacity (4,00,500 TPA) will be reached only once the plant is fully operational in 2026, hence classified as Nearing Completion rather than fully Completed. Self-executed; no separate civil contractor disclosed.

name: Patil Group Chandrapur Spring Steel Wire Plant
description: Patil Group is setting up a greenfield spring steel wire production plant with 50,000 MTPA capacity in Chandrapur, Maharashtra, covering wire diameters of 0.2mm to 8.0mm for automotive, power, construction and engineering applications, including a fully automated tunnel pickling line. Exact operating subsidiary within the Patil Group not specified in source; investment value and precise timeline not disclosed. Self-executed; no separate civil contractor disclosed.

name: Bansal Wire Industries Sanand Greenfield Wire and Steel Plant
description: Bansal Wire Industries Ltd is setting up a Rs 600 crore greenfield project on a 42-acre site in Sanand, Gujarat, comprising a 1.8 lakh-tonne induction-based steel unit and a 60,000-tonne low-carbon and stainless steel wire manufacturing unit, including tyre bead wire, targeted for completion by September 2027. Project includes a 1.8 lakh TPA induction-furnace steelmaking unit (backward integration) alongside the 60,000 TPA wire-processing unit; included here on the basis of its wire-manufacturing component, which is the company's core downstream processing business. Land (42 acres) acquired for approx Rs 80-90 crore. Self-executed; no separate civil contractor disclosed.

name: Bansal Wire Dadri Steel Cord Manufacturing Plant
description: Bansal Wire Industries Ltd is building India's first indigenous steel cord manufacturing facility at its Dadri (Greater Noida) plant in Uttar Pradesh, starting with a 20,000-tonne pilot unit costing Rs 150 crore, as part of a planned Rs 2,500 crore steel cord investment to reduce import dependence for tyre reinforcement material. Rs 150 crore figure is for the initial 20,000-tonne pilot facility, scheduled for commissioning by end of 2026; full steel cord vertical envisages up to Rs 2,500 crore of the company's Rs 3,500 crore five-year capex plan, phased over the next three years. Self-executed; no separate civil contractor disclosed.

name: Daikin India Third Manufacturing Facility, Sri City
description: Daikin Airconditioning India set up its third integrated manufacturing facility at Sri City, Andhra Pradesh, with an investment of Rs 1,000 crore, making it one of the company's largest air-conditioner production bases in India; commercial production was announced in November 2023. Foundation stone laid around April 2022; commercial production announced November 2023. Exact day-level dates not disclosed in sources, so left null rather than guessed.

name: Climaveneta HVAC Manufacturing Plant, Narsapura
description: Mitsubishi Electric Group company Climaveneta Climate Technologies invested Rs 400 crore in a manufacturing facility at Narsapura (Kolar district), Karnataka, to produce central air-conditioning equipment such as screw chillers, magnetic levitation chillers, and heat pumps; the plant was inaugurated on November 8, 2024.

name: Voltas Room AC Manufacturing Plant, Madharapakkam
description: Voltas built a new Room Air Conditioner manufacturing facility spread over 150 acres at Madharapakkam in Thiruvallur district, Tamil Nadu, with a planned investment of over Rs 500 crore; the Bhoomi Pujan was held on May 24, 2023 and commercial operations began during FY2024-25. Commercial production commenced during FY2024-25 (April 2024-March 2025); exact commissioning date not disclosed in sources.

name: Amber Enterprises Ultra Mega AC Manufacturing Facility, YEIDA
description: Amber Enterprises broke ground on a 100-acre 'Ultra Mega' air-conditioner and electronics-component manufacturing facility in Sector 8, YEIDA (near Jewar Airport), Uttar Pradesh, with a disclosed investment of Rs 3,532 crore, on June 27, 2026. This is one of two facilities in a combined Rs 6,785 crore Amber Group YEIDA announcement; Rs 3,532 crore is specifically the Sector 8 AC/electronics-component plant figure. The other component, a Rs 3,250 crore PCB/semiconductor-substrate plant in Sector 10 by group JV Ascent-K Circuit, is not HVAC-related and is excluded here.

name: Intellion Park District Cooling System, Chennai
description: Tata Power, in a consortium with Keppel's infrastructure arm, will deploy a 12,100 TR AI-driven Cooling-as-a-Service district cooling system for Tata Realty's Intellion Park IT campus (25.27 acres) in Chennai's Taramani corridor, under a 15-year agreement targeted to go live in October 2026. Contract value not publicly disclosed. Structured as a 15-year Cooling-as-a-Service agreement (12,100 TR capacity) rather than a fixed-price construction contract; go-live targeted for October 2026.
contractor: Tata Power Trading Company Limited / Keppel Infrastructure (consortium)
client: Infopark Properties Limited (Tata Realty & Infrastructure Ltd)

name: Blue Star Sri City RAC Plant Phase 3 Expansion
description: Blue Star is investing Rs 200 crore in a third-phase capacity expansion of its Sri City, Andhra Pradesh plant, adding 12 lakh units of room air-conditioner production capacity (from 8.5 lakh units), part of a broader Rs 400 crore FY26 capex plan announced in March 2025. Part of Blue Star's Rs 400 crore FY26 capacity expansion plan announced March 2025; specific commissioning date not disclosed.

name: Blue Star Himachal Pradesh Commercial AC Facility Expansion
description: Blue Star is investing Rs 150 crore to expand its commercial air-conditioning manufacturing facility in Himachal Pradesh, as part of its Rs 400 crore FY26 capacity expansion plan announced in March 2025. Part of Blue Star's Rs 400 crore FY26 capacity expansion plan; the specific town/city within Himachal Pradesh and commissioning date are not disclosed in the source, so city is left null rather than guessed.

name: EPACK Durable Andhra Pradesh Manufacturing Expansion
description: EPACK Durable and its subsidiary EPACK Manufacturing Technologies received Andhra Pradesh government approval for a combined Rs 1,084.31 crore investment to expand room air-conditioner, key-component, and other consumer-durables manufacturing capacity, with 36.41 acres of land allotted at Rs 60 lakh/acre under the state's Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0. Andhra Pradesh government approval reported around July 2026 under Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0. Combined figure includes Rs 314.31 crore from EPACK Durable and Rs 770 crore from subsidiary EPACK Manufacturing Technologies (EMTPL); exact plant location/city not specified in source, so left null.
client: EPACK Durable Limited / EPACK Manufacturing Technologies Pvt Ltd

name: Havells Lloyd AC Capacity Expansion, Ghiloth and Sri City
description: Havells India's Lloyd brand invested Rs 50-60 crore to expand air-conditioner manufacturing capacity at its Ghiloth (Rajasthan) and Sri City (Andhra Pradesh) plants, raising combined annual capacity toward about 3 million units, targeted for completion by Q4 FY25 (by March 2025). Investment reported across sources as a Rs 50-60 crore range (funded via internal accruals); expansion spans two plants, Ghiloth in Rajasthan and Sri City in Andhra Pradesh (some secondary sources mislabel Sri City as being in Tamil Nadu); state/city fields here reflect the Ghiloth site only.

name: Airedale by Modine Data Center Cooling Facility, Chennai
description: Modine officially opened a new 100,000 sq ft manufacturing facility in Chennai, Tamil Nadu on August 21, 2025 to produce Airedale by Modine data-center cooling equipment (starting with the AireWall ONE fan wall) for the Asia-Pacific region. Investment value not disclosed in company announcement.

name: Mahira Kohinoor Phase II
description: Residential apartment project (2/3/4 BHK) developed by Mahira Ventures Pvt. Ltd. at Khanammet/Izzathnagar, Serilingampally, Hyderabad; RERA registered as P02400002867. Developer entity is legally named 'Mahira Ventures Private Limited (formerly known as Mahira Power Systems Private Limited)' per the RERA listing. Real-estate aggregator listings (e.g. gharpe.com) show possession targeted for around March 2027, but this exact date is not confirmed on an official Mahira source, so start/end dates are left null. Project value not disclosed.

name: My Home Sayuk
description: Mega residential project of 3,780 flats across 12 towers (G+39) on 25.37 acres at Gopanpally-Tellapur Road, Hyderabad, forming part of the Tellapur Techno City integrated township — a joint venture between My Home Group and Pratima Group. Part of a larger integrated township (Tellapur Techno City) that will also include a mall, international school and hospital per press coverage. Project cost not disclosed in sources reviewed.

name: My Home Krishe
description: Residential apartment complex of about 650 units (2 & 3 BHK, G+26, 4 towers) on 6.7 acres in Gachibowli/Financial District, Hyderabad; RERA registered under P02400000003. Listed as 'Ready to Occupy' on the developer's own site; earlier press material indicated possession around Feb/March 2024, so marked Completed. Exact handover date and project cost not disclosed.

name: Sumadhura Epitome
description: A three-tower residential community of 262 homes (2/3/4 BHK) on 3.75 acres at Rachenahalli, North Bengaluru, just behind Manyata Tech Park. The Rs 500 Cr figure reported is the company's projected sales revenue potential for the project, not a disclosed construction/project cost — treat with that caveat.

name: Sumadhura Palais Royale
description: Ultra-luxury residential project of 523 units (4 & 5 BHK) across three towers on 7.35 acres in the Financial District, Hyderabad, with a biophilic design and over 85% green open space. The Rs 2,500 Cr figure is the company's projected sales revenue potential for the project, not a disclosed construction/project cost — treat with that caveat.

name: Sumadhura Capitol Residences
description: Residential project offering 3 & 4 BHK luxury apartments in Whitefield, East Bengaluru, close to Kadugodi Tree Park Metro Station and the ITPL business hub. The Rs 1,000 Cr figure is the company's projected sales revenue potential for the project, not a disclosed construction/project cost — treat with that caveat.

name: Total Environment The Magic Faraway Tree
description: Residential apartment project (3 & 4 BHK, ~360-434 units across phases) on a roughly 10-11.5 acre site on Kanakapura Road/Thalaghattapura, South Bengaluru; RERA registered (PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/171015/000424 and PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/181204/002194). Unit-count and acreage figures vary slightly across listing sites (10 vs 11.5 acres; 360 vs 434 units); status inferred from RERA phase registration years (2017/2018) and aggregator listings, not an official completion notice. Project cost not disclosed.

name: Total Environment In That Quiet Earth
description: Residential project of 560 units (2/3/4 BHK) spanning 14.5 acres on Hennur Road/Avalahalli, North Bengaluru, developed in multiple RERA-registered phases (1, 2a, 2b) with scheduled possession around June 2026. Possession/end date is the RERA-filed target (approx June 1, 2026) for the phase reviewed; later phase(s) (2b, RERA registered 2022) may extend beyond this. Project cost not disclosed.

name: Prestige Trade Centre (facade package), Mulund, Mumbai
description: Innovators Facade Systems Ltd secured a Rs 110 crore work order from Prestige Mulund Realty Pvt. Ltd. (a Prestige Group entity) for design, development, supply, fabrication and installation of facade works including stone cladding, with a contracted completion window of 15 months from commencement. Order announced 22 Nov 2024 via stock-exchange disclosure (Innovators Facade Systems Ltd is BSE/NSE-listed). Contracted 15-month duration implies a scheduled completion around Feb 2026; independent confirmation of actual physical completion status was not found.

name: PDMC / Comprehensive Project Management Services for AMRUT — Karnataka Urban Water Supply Projects
description: IPE Global acted as Project Development & Management Consultant (PDMC) providing planning, feasibility, engineering design, procurement support, construction supervision, contract management and monitoring for urban water supply and sewerage projects under the Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT/AMRUT 2.0) across more than 200 urban local bodies in Karnataka (also cited for Jammu & Kashmir and Chhattisgarh under AMRUT 1.0), contributing to the creation of 27 water treatment plants and 38 sewage treatment plants and piped water/sewer connections to 600,000+ households across 37 cities nationally. IMPORTANT: IPE Global is a Project Management Consultant (PMC/PDMC), NOT a construction contractor — it does not execute civil works itself. It is included here because it holds a disclosed, named role as PMU/PDMC on a specific government infrastructure programme (AMRUT). Contract value not disclosed on the source page; national portfolio share cited as ~9% of AMRUT. A related, separately-cited engagement is PDMC training under AMRUT 2.0 for KUWS&DB (source: https://www.ipeglobal.com/pdmc-team-conducted-training-programme-under-amrut-2-0-for-karnataka-urban-water-supply-drainage-board-kuwsdb).
client: Karnataka Urban Water Supply & Drainage Board (KUWS&DB) / Government of Karnataka (AMRUT programme)

name: Kapil Business Park (World Trade Center Shamshabad)
description: A Grade A+ commercial development of roughly 10.08 acres (G+11, approx. 7.5 lakh sq ft) near Hyderabad International Airport in Shamshabad, positioned to house 'World Trade Center Shamshabad' in association with the WTC Association, USA. Marketed by Kapil Group's commercial real-estate arm (Kapil Commercial/Kapil Business Park) as a pre-leasable/rental-yield investment asset, which suggests advanced-stage/near-complete construction, but no official completion date or project cost was found. One third-party listing aggregator attributed the project to a different developer entity name ('BVM Energy And Residency'), which could not be corroborated against Kapil Group's own sites — flagged for verification before outreach.

name: Kapil Kavuri Hub
description: A commercial office development of approximately 687,072 sq ft (12-storey tower) in the Nanakramguda Financial District, Hyderabad, marketed as a premium commercial investment destination. Currently marketed as an operating leasing/investment asset (implying construction complete), but no official completion date or project cost was found on Kapil Group's own sites.

name: Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC)
description: L&W Construction executed civil, façade, landscape and external development works for Boeing's global engineering and technology campus in Bengaluru, inaugurated by PM Modi on 19 January 2024 as Boeing's largest such facility outside the US. L&W's own website lists this among its ongoing projects (civil, facade, landscape, external development). The ~Rs 1,600 crore figure widely reported in the press is Boeing's total campus investment, not L&W's specific contract value, which is undisclosed. Main campus (B1/B2 buildings) was inaugurated Jan 2024; a further phase (Phase 1A) was reported ongoing.

name: 4-Laning of Kadapa–China Orampadu Section of NH-716 (Package I, Kadapa-Renigunta)
description: Hybrid Annuity Mode contract for 4-laning a 64.2 km stretch of NH-716 between Kadapa and China Orampadu in Andhra Pradesh, part of the Kadapa-Renigunta section under Bharatmala Pariyojana. LOA awarded 24 Mar 2023 under Bharatmala Pariyojana, HAM model; length 64.2 km. Value corroborated by NHAI's awarded-projects list and a CARE Ratings press release on the concessionaire (combined value of both Package I and II: Rs 2,254.44 crore).
contractor: Lakshmi Infrastructure & Developers India Pvt. Ltd.

name: 4-Laning of China Orampadu–Renigunta Section of NH-716 (Package II, Kadapa-Renigunta)
description: Hybrid Annuity Mode contract for 4-laning a 57.735 km stretch of NH-716 from China Orampadu to Renigunta in Andhra Pradesh, part of the Kadapa-Renigunta section under Bharatmala Pariyojana. LOA awarded 24 Mar 2023 (same date as Package I), HAM model; length 57.735 km, spans Annamayya, Tirupati, YSR Kadapa and Chittoor districts.
contractor: Lakshmi Infrastructure & Developers India Pvt. Ltd.

name: New BG Railway Line, Indore–Budni Section (Kheri–Pipaliya Nankar), Bhopal Division
description: MKC Infrastructure was awarded a Rs 699.98 crore RVNL contract (emerging L1 bidder, 31.48% below NIT cost) for construction of roadbed, bridges, buildings and track-linking works (excluding supply of rails/sleepers) on a new broad-gauge line between Kheri and Pipaliya Nankar stations on the Indore-Budni section, West Central Railway. Financial bid opened 4 Apr 2025; contract execution period 36 months. Part of RVNL's broader Indore-Budni new railway line project, which has multiple separate packages awarded to different contractors (e.g., D.P. Jain, IRCON-JV).
client: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL) / West Central Railway

name: 4-Laning of Belgaum–Hungund–Raichur Section of NH748A (Package-2, BHR-II)
description: Hybrid Annuity Mode NHAI project for 4-laning with paved shoulders a 46.1 km stretch (design Ch. 43.800 to 89.900) of NH748A in Karnataka, part of the Panaji-Hyderabad (EC10) economic corridor, executed through MKC's project SPV Nanjundeshwara Highways Pvt Ltd. Executed via MKC's project SPV, 'MKC Belgaum-Raichur (Pkg-2) Nanjundeshwara Highways Pvt Ltd'; rated by Infomerics (IVR A-/IVR A2+, Stable outlook). Length 46.1 km.

name: Barner Reservoir Scheme, Jamui District
description: NCC secured a Rs 2,090.50 crore order from the Bihar Water Resources Department to build the Barner Reservoir Scheme in Jamui district, covering reservoir and dam structures and irrigation channels, with a 30-month construction period followed by a 60-month defect liability period. Announced 15 Sep 2025. 30-month construction phase plus 60-month defect liability period, aimed at improving irrigation reliability and water management in Jamui district. A new/additional order not part of NCC's previously tracked project list.
client: Water Resources Department, Government of Bihar

name: Mumbai Metro Line 6 – Rolling Stock, Signalling & PSD Systems (Package 1-CA-232)
description: NCC won a Rs 2,269 crore MMRDA contract for design, manufacture, supply, installation, integration, testing and commissioning of rolling stock, signalling/train control, telecom, platform screen doors and depot machinery/plant for the Swami Samarth Nagar–Vikhroli (EEH) stretch of Mumbai Metro Line 6. LoA dated 11 Jul 2025. 24-month execution period, followed by 2-year defect liability period and 5-year comprehensive maintenance. A new/additional order not part of NCC's previously tracked project list; notably a systems (E&M) contract rather than civil works.

name: Mumbai-Ahmedabad High Speed Rail (Bullet Train) Track Slab Precasting Plant - Kim, Gujarat
description: PCM Cement Concrete Pvt. Ltd., in joint venture with Germany's RAIL.ONE GmbH (which PCM's parent group acquired in 2013), set up a precast track-slab manufacturing plant at Kim near Surat, Gujarat, described as the largest train-track-slab manufacturing facility in the country, to supply J-slab ballastless track components for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High Speed Rail corridor. PCM Group's own website attributes the RAIL.ONE joint venture and the Kim, Gujarat slab-track plant to PCM Cement Concrete Pvt. Ltd. Independent news coverage (e.g. Millennium Post, NewsOnAir) confirms the Kim facility as a real, active MAHSR track-slab plant, but does not itself name PCM as the operator, so the PCM-specific attribution rests on the company's own site. Contract value and dates not disclosed in available sources; NHSRCL is a Government of India/State JV special-purpose company, funded mainly by GoI/GoG/GoM equity plus a JICA soft loan.
client: National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL)

name: VINP Ltd. 200 KLPD Grain-Based Distillery, Karnataka
description: Regreen-Excel EPC India Ltd. (formerly Excel Engineers and Consultants) executed a 200 KLPD grain-based ethanol distillery project for VINP Ltd. in Karnataka, part of its portfolio of grain distillery module installations for ethanol production. Reported by trade publication ChiniMandi as part of Regreen-Excel's project references; exact value, dates and city not disclosed in the source. Status of 'Completed' is inferred from its listing as an executed reference project rather than an explicit completion statement.

name: Devsristi Bio Ltd. 250 KLPD Grain-Based Distillery, Telangana
description: Regreen-Excel EPC India Ltd. executed a 250 KLPD grain-based distillery project for Devsristi Bio Ltd. in Telangana as part of its ethanol/distillery EPC project portfolio. Reported by trade publication ChiniMandi as part of Regreen-Excel's project references; exact value, dates and city not disclosed in the source. Status inferred from listing as an executed reference project.

name: CDBL 275 KLPD Grain Distillery, Chandigarh
description: Regreen-Excel EPC India Ltd. built a 275 KLPD grain-based distillery for CDBL in Chandigarh, described by the company as among its single largest grain distillery plants in operation. Source describes plant as 'in operation', supporting Completed status. Full form of 'CDBL' and exact contract value/dates not disclosed in the source.

name: DSCL Sugars Ltd. 275 KLPD Molasses-Based Distillery, Uttar Pradesh
description: Regreen-Excel EPC India Ltd. built a 275 KLPD molasses-based distillery for DSCL Sugars Ltd. in Uttar Pradesh, cited by the company as among its single largest molasses distillery plants in operation. Source describes plant as 'in operation', supporting Completed status. Exact contract value, dates and city not disclosed in the source.

name: NH-127B Darugiri-Songsak-Williamnagar Two-Laning with Paved Shoulder, Meghalaya
description: Shivalaya Construction Co. Pvt. Ltd. (now Shivalaya Construction Limited) emerged as the lowest (L1) bidder for a NHIDCL EPC contract to improve and widen National Highway 127B (Darugiri-Songsak-Williamnagar Junction section, design length 36.635 km) to two lanes with paved shoulder in East Garo Hills district, Meghalaya. This entity was originally incorporated in Delhi in 1997 as 'Shivalaya Construction Company Private Limited' and converted to a public limited company ('Shivalaya Construction Limited') ahead of a 2025 IPO filing - confirmed to be the same New Delhi (Paschim Vihar)-headquartered roads/highways EPC company, not the unrelated entities sometimes referred to loosely as 'Shivalaya Constructions'. Status reflects L1 (lowest bidder) position at time of reporting; formal award/contract signing date not independently confirmed in available sources.
client: National Highways & Infrastructure Development Corporation Ltd. (NHIDCL)

name: Chennai Metro Phase II Line-3 Package UG-03 (KMC to Royapettah Underground Section)
description: URC Construction Pvt. Ltd. commenced construction work on Package UG-03 of Chennai Metro Phase II Line-3 (Corridor 3), covering underground stations at KMC, Sterling Road Junction, Nungambakkam, Gemini and Thousand Lights plus the Thousand Lights crossover, as well as non-diaphragm-wall works at Royapettah Government Hospital and Chetpet stations; RVNL had been awarded the overall ₹1,328.89 crore EPC contract by Chennai Metro Rail Ltd. and engaged URC for this scope. URC Construction's specific subcontract value from RVNL is undisclosed; the ₹1,328.89 crore figure is RVNL's overall Package UG-03 EPC contract value from CMRL (awarded July 2023, 1,725-day/~4.7-year deadline). Chennai Metro Phase 2 funding is a mix of Government of India, Government of Tamil Nadu and multilateral (JICA) loan components; classified here as State given CMRL's state-PSU structure.
client: Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL), via Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL)

name: NH-27 Jetpur-Gondal-Rajkot Section Widening to Six Lanes (Km 117.600 to Km 185.00), Gujarat
description: A joint venture of Engineering Projects (India) Ltd. and Varaha Infra Limited was awarded the EPC contract to widen the existing 4-lane Jetpur-Gondal-Rajkot section of NH-27 (km 117.600 to km 185.00) to six lanes under Bharatmala Pariyojana, with a tender value of approximately Rs. 1,580.49 crore; construction is under progress with a target completion around January 2027.
